theater: 科威特與伊拉克南部沙漠戰線

battle.name: 沙漠風暴
battle.theater: 科威特與伊拉克南部沙漠戰線
battle.brief: 一九九一年一月十六日至二月二十八日，以美國為首的聯軍對伊拉克發動沙漠風暴。空襲階段日均出動逾千架次，二月二十四日地面部隊自科威特以西大迂迴，四十八小時內攻入科威特城。卡面一九八〇年列裝的M1艾布蘭是突擊縱隊骨幹。夜視、精確導引與制空權決定戰局；後勤仍在，不打城市。

kit.name: 艾布蘭
kit.history: 燃氣渦輪與複合裝甲。1991 年的優勢同時是夜視、訓練與後勤，不是單車無敵。

countries: 沙漠風暴由以美國為首的聯軍對伊拉克共和國開打，聯軍共三十二個國家，規模是二次大戰以來最大的多國聯合軍事行動之一。戰區指揮由美軍中央司令部司令諾曼·施瓦茨科普夫上將統一掌握，下設以沙特阿拉伯為基地的聯合部隊司令部、駐英軍中央東方司令部與駐巴林的海軍中央司令部；英國承擔歐洲部隊的空中支援與海上封鎖，法國第四裝甲師與英國第一裝甲師直接編入地面作戰序列。地面主力為美軍第七軍（第一裝甲師、第三步兵師、第四裝甲師及多國旅）、第十八空降軍（第八十二空降師、第一百零一空降師）、第一騎兵師、第二十四步兵師與第十一、第十二空降旅，另有埃及、科威特、敘利亞、摩洛哥等國的營旅級部隊在中東戰線協同。伊拉克方面由薩達姆·侯賽因直接掌權，陸軍以裝甲師、機械化師與步兵師組成三個方面軍，共和國衛軍與西部軍區指揮部握有精銳，全國防空由空軍、防空部隊與地對地飛彈單位合體運作，並以北飛的飛彈與飛機對科威特境內目標施以打擊。
countriesEn: Desert Storm was fought by a coalition led by the United States against the Republic of Iraq, and brought together thirty-two nations in the largest multinational coalition operation since the Second World War. Theatre command was held by General H. Norman Schwarzkopf Jr. as commander of US Central Command, with three subordinate headquarters beneath him: the Joint Forces Command in Saudi Arabia, the British Central Eastern Command for the European contingents, and Naval Central Command in Bahrain. Britain provided the air support and the maritime blockade for the European forces, while the French 4th Armoured Division and the British 1st Armoured Division were inserted directly into the ground order of battle. On the ground the main effort was the US Seventh Corps (1st Armored, 3rd Infantry and 4th Armored Divisions with a multinational brigade), XVIII Airborne Corps (82nd and 101st Airborne Divisions), the 1st Cavalry Division, the 24th Infantry Division and the 11th and 12th Airborne Brigades, with Egyptian, Kuwaiti, Syrian and Moroccan units of battalion and brigade size fighting alongside in the central Gulf sector. Iraq was ruled directly by Saddam Hussein: its army organised armoured, mechanised and infantry divisions into three army group commands, with the Republican Guard and the Western Army Group holding the best equipped formations. Air defence was run jointly by the Iraqi Air Force, the army air defence formations and the surface-to-surface missile brigades, which struck targets inside Kuwait with missiles and aircraft.
people: 關鍵人物集中在聯軍一側。諾曼·施瓦茨科普夫上將任中央司令部司令，是整場戰役的設計者，主張以縱深迂迴代替正面強攻，並在波斯灣與沙特兩地分設指揮所。第七軍中將弗雷德里克·弗蘭克斯接掌西線主攻，第八十二空降師中將詹姆斯·格里茨負責科威特西部插入，第一裝甲師少將伯納德·羅傑斯率領突擊縱隊，第一騎兵師的戰車旅與裝甲旅則是迂迴縱隊的刀鋒。空中作戰由空軍中將查爾斯·霍納在利雅得的中央司令部空軍司令部統一調度，同基地的英軍空中指揮所負責歐洲機隊。沙特方面，蘇丹·本·薩勒曼親王主持防空與後勤，卡利德·本·阿卜杜勒阿齊茲親王指揮沙特地面部隊，其身邊有美軍中校約翰·桑德萊因任顧問，後者在哈夫季戰鬥中扮演關鍵協調角色。法國由參謀總長讓·讓卡率團參戰。伊拉克方面，除薩達姆·侯賽因的決策層外，具名指揮官多為共和國衛軍與各裝甲師師長，史料因戰後檔案封存與政治因素而多有缺失。
peopleEn: Most of the named decision-makers were on the coalition side. Schwarzkopf designed the whole campaign, argued for a flanking move in depth instead of a frontal assault, and ran separate forward command posts in the Gulf and in Saudi Arabia. Lieutenant General Frederick Franks Jr. took command of the western main effort in VII Corps, Lieutenant General James Gritz led the 82nd Airborne Division on the western flank of Kuwait, Major General Bernard Rogers commanded the 1st Armored Division, and the tank and armoured regiments of the 1st Cavalry Division formed the tip of the turning force. Air operations were controlled by Lieutenant General Charles Horner from the Central Command Air Forces headquarters at Riyadh, with a British air headquarters on the same base responsible for the European aircraft. On the Saudi side, Prince Sultan bin Salman directed air defence and logistics, and Prince Khalid bin Abdulaziz led the Saudi ground forces, advised by the American lieutenant colonel John Sandline, whose coordination role in the Battle of Khafji proved decisive. France sent a force under its chief of staff, General Jeancka. On the Iraqi side the documented names are thin: apart from Saddam Hussein's own circle, most commanders are known only as Republican Guard or divisional leaders, because records were destroyed or sealed away after the war.
kits: 卡面這件艾布蘭（M1 Abrams）是一九八〇年量產的美國主戰坦克，在沙漠風暴中屬於聯軍裝甲部隊的骨幹。第一裝甲師與多數第一騎兵師部隊配備M1A1改良型：一二〇毫米滑膛炮、AGT-1500燃氣渦輪發動機約一千五百匹馬力、複合裝甲與側裙模組，戰鬥全重約六十三至六十八噸，後艙彈架可容五十發穿甲彈，主要用於正面突破與對伊拉克T-55、T-62、T-72的射擊。第四裝甲師在開戰前正進行M1A1換裝，兩種型號並行，可靠性因此偏低，許多戰車在進攻前就已送修。與艾布蘭協同的是M2布萊德利步兵戰車、M113裝甲車、HMMWV裝甲車、AH-64阿帕契武裝直升機與M270多管火箭炮；炮兵以M109自走榴砲與M109A6帕拉丁一五五毫米自行榴彈炮為骨幹，其射擊節奏直接決定突擊速度。空中有F-15E Strike Eagle、F-16C與D型、A-10攻擊機、F-117隱形攻擊機、預警機與空中加油機，BGM-109戰斧巡弋飛彈用於縱深打擊，愛國者攔截飛彈用於反飛彈攔截。伊拉克以T-72與T-62主力坦克、BMP系列裝甲車、ZSU-23-4自走高射砲、地對地飛彈與技術車輛組成，並以大量塹壕、地雷與假目標構成防線。
kitsEn: The card's M1 Abrams was the standardised American main battle tank of 1980 and the backbone of the coalition armoured forces. The 1st Armored Division and most of the 1st Cavalry Division fielded the improved M1A1: a 120 mm smoothbore gun, an AGT-1500 gas turbine of roughly fifteen hundred horsepower, composite armour with side skirts, a combat weight of about sixty-three to sixty-eight tonnes, and a bustle rack holding fifty rounds of anti-armour ammunition, used for breach work and for engagements against Iraqi T-55, T-62 and T-72 tanks. The 4th Armored Division was still converting to the M1A1 when the war began, and the mixture of models was less reliable, with many vehicles withdrawn for repair before the attack. Working with the Abrams were the M2 Bradley infantry fighting vehicle, the M113, the HMMWV, the AH-64 Apache and the M270 rocket launcher. Artillery rested on the M109 and the M109A6 Paladin 155 mm self-propelled howitzer, whose rate of fire set the tempo of the advance. In the air, F-15E Strike Eagles, F-16C and D aircraft, A-10 attack aircraft, F-117 stealth attackers, airborne warning and tanker aircraft provided the strike force, with BGM-109 Tomahawk cruise missiles used against deep targets and Patriot interceptors used against ballistic missiles. Iraq answered with T-72 and T-62 tanks, BMP-series armoured vehicles, ZSU-23-4 anti-aircraft guns, surface-to-surface missiles and technicals, backed by long lines of trenches, mines and decoys.
tactics: 戰役分空襲與地面兩段。空襲階段以壓制敵方防空、摧毀機場與跑道為主，聯軍每日出動逾千架次，頭三天集中打擊伊拉克北部與中部機群，使用誘餌殘骸與地面火光欺騙雷達，並以隱形機與中距離精確導引武器在夜間突襲，電子干擾與假射擊同時施放。地面階段由施瓦茨科普夫與弗蘭克斯制定左勾拳迂迴：第七軍主力西移數百公里，越過幼發拉底河與沙漠地帶，直取巴士拉至科威特城的公路，第十八空降軍的插入部隊封住科威特西部缺口，海上航空兵與水面艦隊同時打擊暴露在原野上的伊軍縱隊。裝甲部隊依照美軍準則進行縱深攻擊，自師、旅、營分界線逐級推進，並以目標分配程序把空襲任務逐日指派給各師；坦克乘員按五要點與四眼制度操作，車長負責觀察、副手操作瞄準，夜戰靠熱像與夜視瞄具取勝，發現目標的距離遠超肉眼所見。伊拉克軍隊沿科威特境內縱深構築數百公里的塹壕與工事帶，採取人海戰術與自殺式突擊，聯軍因此不進入城區，改以包圍與側擊消耗其抵抗。
tacticsEn: The campaign ran in two phases. The air phase aimed at suppressing Iraqi air defences and destroying airfields and runways: the coalition flew more than a thousand sorties a day, concentrated the first three days against the northern and central Iraqi air bases, used dummy wrecks and ground fires to deceive radar, and struck at night with stealth aircraft and mid-range precision weapons while electronic jamming and feigned attacks were run in parallel. The ground phase was the left hook designed by Schwarzkopf and Franks: the bulk of VII Corps shifted several hundred kilometres west across the desert and the Euphrates to seize the Basra-Kuwait City highway, XVIII Airborne Corps landed on the western flank of Kuwait to close the gap, and carrier aircraft and the surface fleet struck Iraqi columns caught in the open. Armoured units worked to the US doctrine of attack in the depth, moving down from division to brigade to battalion boundaries, with the targeting process assigning each day's air strikes to individual divisions. Tank crews worked to the five fundamentals and the four-eyes rule, the commander looking while the gunner aimed, and night fighting was decided by thermal sights and image intensifiers, the range at which a target could be seen far exceeding naked eye. The Iraqi army built several hundred kilometres of berms and trench lines in depth across Kuwait and relied on massed infantry and suicide-style assaults, so the coalition avoided the cities and took the defences apart from the flanks instead.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下：戰役自一九九一年一月十六日空襲開始，至二月二十八日伊拉克宣布接受停火，前後四十二天。聯軍共三十二國，總兵力約九十五萬人，進入戰區者近七十萬，空中作戰兵力逾兩千八百架，艦艇逾一千艘；空襲階段總出動架次約三萬九千次，開戰首日即達一千四百架次。伊拉克常被估計有六十餘萬兵力，約五千輛坦克與數千門火炮，戰機近七百架，結果在戰役中報廢的伊軍飛機逾三百架，另有大批飛機與直升機飛往伊朗。聯軍方面因敵方作戰造成的死亡為一百四十八人、受傷一百四十五人；伊拉克軍方傷亡的統計分歧極大，無法核對，被俘的伊拉克軍人達數萬之眾，裝甲對決中擊毀或繳獲的伊拉克坦克數以數百計。日常消耗方面，聯軍每日需用燃料約兩百萬加侖，絕大部分靠海運與空運送上岸。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked roughly run as follows. The campaign opened with the air strike on 16 January 1991 and ended when Iraq accepted the ceasefire on 28 February, forty-two days in all. The coalition fielded thirty-two nations, about nine hundred and fifty-six thousand personnel in total with close to seven hundred thousand actually deployed in theatre, more than two thousand eight hundred aircraft and over a thousand warships. About thirty-nine thousand sorties were flown during the air phase, fourteen hundred of them on the first day alone. Iraq is usually estimated at more than six hundred thousand troops, some five thousand tanks, several thousand artillery pieces and close to seven hundred combat aircraft; more than three hundred Iraqi aircraft were destroyed and a large number of aircraft and helicopters were flown into Iran. Coalition deaths attributable to enemy action were officially given as one hundred and forty-eight killed and one hundred and forty-five wounded. Iraqi losses are estimated so widely that the figures cannot be reconciled, tens of thousands of Iraqi soldiers ended up in captivity, and several hundred Iraqi tanks were destroyed or captured in the armoured fighting. On the logistics side the coalition burned about two million gallons of fuel every day, most of it lifted in by sea and by air.
cause: 導火線是一九九〇年八月二日伊拉克對科威特的入侵。背景是八〇年代石油價格崩跌與產油配額之爭：伊拉克在波斯灣的石油收入銳減、外債積壓，而科威特對石油課稅與產量的要求不願讓步，兩國又在拉馬拉油田的界線與斜鑽問題上僵持不下。薩達姆·侯賽因判斷科威特實力有限、內部不穩，並誤估美國不會為海灣而開戰，遂下令出兵。伊軍在不足兩日內以逾十萬兵力與數千輛坦克攻入科威特，攻陷首都、控制石油設施，並點燃數百口油井企圖使科威特油源報廢。聯合國安理會於一九九〇年十一月二十九日以第六七八號決議授權會員國動用武力，一九九一年一月十五日再以第六八七號決議訂下停火條件。以美軍為主的聯軍自一九九〇年八月起執行沙漠之盾部署，把部隊送進沙特與土耳其的基地；在蘇聯解體、阿拉伯與歐洲國家一致施壓的背景下，外交限期被轉成軍事倒數。
causeEn: The trigger was the Iraqi invasion of Kuwait on 2 August 1990. The background was the collapse of oil prices in the 1980s and the quarrel over production quotas: Iraq's oil revenues from the Gulf fell sharply and its foreign debts piled up, Kuwait's demands on taxation and output would not soften, and the two states deadlocked over the border and the slant drilling in the Ramala oil field. Saddam Hussein judged Kuwait to be weak and divided, and miscalculated that America would not fight over the Gulf, so he ordered the invasion. Iraqi forces took Kuwait in under two days with more than a hundred thousand troops and thousands of tanks, occupied the capital, seized the oil installations and set fire to hundreds of wells to spoil Kuwait's oil. The United Nations Security Council authorised the use of force in Resolution 678 on 29 November 1990 and set out the terms for a ceasefire in Resolution 687 on 15 January 1991. The US-led coalition had been assembling in strength since August 1990 under Operation Desert Shield, and as the Soviet Union dissolved and Arab and European governments pressed in unison, the diplomatic deadline was turned into a military countdown.
impact: 沙漠風暴留下的第一重影響是戰爭形態的改觀。精確導引、夜視與熱像、衛星與定時資料鏈、以及海運後勤，讓美軍第一次以遠低於二次大戰的兵力密度取得壓倒性勝利，也讓各國重新計算國防現代化的成本，成為九〇年代各國購置裝甲與夜視裝備的樣板。第二重影響在政治上：這場勝利被當作冷戰後新世界秩序的第一課，直接推動美國在九〇年代的介入路線，隨後索馬里、盧安達與科威特的聯合國行動都以此為先例，而代價也在一九九三年摩加迪沙與一九九四年盧安達的教訓中顯現。第三重影響是伊拉克未被打垮的現實：戰後聯合國核查才發現伊拉克藏有核與化學武器計畫，安理會第六八七號決議的制裁與兩塊禁飛區隨即建立，一九九八年的沙漠之狐與二〇〇三年的伊拉克戰爭都由此延伸。經濟面上，油價與全球供應鏈短期震盪，科威特重建與主權基金制度成立，戰後的阿拉伯與歐洲外交、以巴關係的馬德里會議，也都以此為背景。
impactEn: The first consequence of Desert Storm was a change in how war was understood. Precision guidance, night vision and thermal imaging, satellite and timed links and sealift logistics allowed the United States to win overwhelmingly with a far lower density of forces than in the Second World War, and it became the model other countries used when costing their own modernisation. The second consequence was political: the victory was presented as the first lesson of a new post-Cold War world order, and it pushed American intervention through the 1990s, with Somalia, Rwanda and later Kosovo following the precedent, and the cost showing in Mogadishu in 1993 and in Rwanda in 1994. The third consequence was the Iraq that was not removed: the post-war inspections revealed nuclear and chemical weapons programmes, the sanctions of Resolution 687 and the two no-fly zones followed, and from there came Desert Fox in 1998 and the invasion of 2003. Economically, oil prices and world supply chains jolted for a time, Kuwait was rebuilt and its sovereign wealth fund was created, and the Madrid conference and the Arab-Israeli track ran against this background.
result: 聯軍在二月二十四日發動代號沙漠風暴地面戰役的一百小時攻勢，二月二十六日伊軍裝甲師在縱深崩潰，科威特城獲解放，巴格達在實質上未經抵抗即被美軍第三步兵師先頭部隊佔領，這段被稱為幽靈戰的推進，成為現代戰爭最著名的一段。二月二十八日上午八時，伊拉克廣播電台宣布接受安理會第六八七號決議的停火條件；戰役以四十二天、聯軍控制科威特全境與南部伊拉克告終，伊拉克軍隊其後在四個月內撤出科威特。事後評價多半認為這是一場戰術上極為徹底而政治上相當有限的勝利：勝負手在制空權、夜視與精確武器、裝甲部隊的訓練與後勤，以及聯軍不進城區的機動取態；而伊軍僵化的指揮體系、人海突擊與在縱深耗盡燃料與補給，才使防線在四十八小時內瓦解。聯軍並未推翻薩達姆，戰爭留下的真正遺產，是此後三十年美國在中東的介入模式，以及一套以資訊與後勤為核心的現代戰爭教科書。
resultEn: The coalition launched its one-hundred-hour ground offensive on 24 February. On the 26th Iraqi armoured divisions collapsed in depth, Kuwait City was liberated, and Baghdad was occupied with virtually no resistance by the leading elements of the 3rd Infantry Division, a movement remembered as the ghost war and the most famous passage in modern land warfare. At eight in the morning on 28 February Iraqi radio announced acceptance of the ceasefire terms of Resolution 687. The campaign ended after forty-two days with the coalition holding all of Kuwait and southern Iraq, and the Iraqi forces completed their withdrawal from Kuwait over the following four months. Later assessment usually calls it a tactical triumph of unusual completeness and a politically limited one. The margin lay in air supremacy, night vision and precision weapons, the training and logistics of the armoured forces, and the coalition's decision to fight around the cities rather than in them, while Iraq's rigid command system, its massed infantry assaults and its exhaustion of fuel and supply in depth broke the front within forty-eight hours. Saddam was not overthrown, and the real legacy of the war was the American pattern of intervention in the Middle East for the next thirty years, together with a modern-war textbook built on information and logistics.
